mapper.select: select r.id, r.order_id as orderId, r.product_id as productId, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.status, r.create_time as createTime, p.name as productName from review r left join product p on p.id = r.product_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc

select r.*, u.name as user_name, p.name as product_name from review r left join user u on r.user_id = u.id left join product p on r.product_id = p.id
and p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by r.create_time desc
mapper.update: update review set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select coalesce(round(avg(rating), 1), 0) as avg_rating, count(*) as total_count, sum(case when rating = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as star5, sum(case when rating = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as star4, sum(case when rating = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as star3, sum(case when rating = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as star2, sum(case when rating = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as star1 from review where product_id = #{productId} and status = 1
